title: 第7章 炼气宝典自毁根基第8章 遭受背叛命悬一线
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
“你对功法感兴趣？”
“不过很可惜，你猜错了。”
“我这门功法，无品。”
李如风不动声色道。
“五品？”
“功法还有其他等级吗？”
听到李如风的回答，徐洋弱弱疑惑道。
“……”
“是没有品级，就是连黄级都算不上。”
见徐洋那呆呆的模样，李如风无奈解释道。
“……”一听这话，徐洋顿时哑口无言，不知道该如何回应。
“你也别想太多。”
“虽然功法是无品，但即便是帝级功法，也不一定能有它珍贵。”
看到徐洋久久没有反应，为了缓解尴尬的气氛，李如风只好开口辩解道。
“比帝级功法还要珍贵？”
“师尊，我没见过什么大世面，您可不要骗我这个小孩子。”徐洋有些不信道。
“没出息，就你这样，我都懒得浪费时间去骗你。”
“赶紧拿着功法到一边去，我要休息了。”
解决徐洋质疑功法最好的办法，那就是直接将功法交给他。
李如风有信心保证，只要徐洋看过一遍他的那门功法，一定不会再出现任何质疑的功法的想法。

“好吧。”接过李如风丢过来的功法又看了一眼闭上双眼的李如风，徐洋最终选择了妥协。
随后，徐洋便来到一旁盘膝坐下，接着便开始查看起手中的那门功法。
“炼气宝典。”
看了一眼功法的名字，徐洋随即翻到第一页。
“注意：欲练此功，必先自毁根基！！！”
看着第一页上写的内容，徐洋第一次感觉世上竟有如此奇怪的功法。
别的功法，要么需要强大的天赋，要么就是非凡的悟性，最差起码也要能正常修炼突破。
但此刻他手中的这本，上来就要你自废根基。
不清楚的还以为这是一本害人的功法呢。
没有再去管第一页的内容，徐洋继续翻到下一页。
“若不废根基，也能修炼此功。”
“代价，终生止步于炼气境。”
“境界高于炼气境修炼此功法，境界会自动跌落到炼气境。”
“注意：一旦修炼，无法终止。”
“欲练此功，三思而行，切记！切记！！！”
“……”看完第二页的内容，徐洋顿时一阵无语。
“既然不用废除根基也能用，那你第一页写那句话，有什么用……”
“算了，重点是在代价上，终身止步于炼气境。”
content_en:
"Are you interested in martial arts?"
"But unfortunately, you guessed wrong."
"This skill of mine is without quality."
Li Rufeng said calmly.
"Fifth grade?"
"Are there other levels of skills?"
After hearing Li Rufeng's answer, Xu Yang said weakly and doubtfully.
"..."
"There is no grade, it's not even a yellow grade."
Seeing Xu Yang's dull look, Li Rufeng explained helplessly.
"..." Upon hearing this, Xu Yang was speechless and didn't know how to respond.
"Don't think too much."
"Although the technique is of no quality, even if it is an emperor-level technique, it may not be as precious as it."
Seeing that Xu Yang didn't respond for a long time, Li Rufeng had no choice but to defend himself in order to ease the awkward atmosphere.
"More precious than the emperor-level skills?"
"Master, I have never seen anything big in the world. Please don't lie to me, a child." Xu Yang didn't believe it.
"You're worthless. As you are, I don't even want to waste my time lying to you."
"Hurry up and take the exercises to the side. I want to rest."
The best way to solve Xu Yang's doubts about the skills is to hand them over to him directly.
Li Rufeng was confident that as long as Xu Yang watched his exercise once, he would never have any doubts about it.
"Okay." After taking the technique thrown by Li Rufeng and looking at Li Rufeng with his eyes closed, Xu Yang finally chose to compromise.
Afterwards, Xu Yang came to the side and sat down cross-legged, and then began to examine the skill in his hand.
"Qi Refining Manual."
After taking a look at the name of the technique, Xu Yang immediately turned to the first page.
"Note: If you want to practice this skill, you must first destroy your foundation!!!"
Looking at what was written on the first page, Xu Yang felt for the first time that there was such a strange skill in the world.
Other techniques require either strong talent or extraordinary understanding. At the very least, they need to be able to practice and break through normally.
But the book in his hand now will force you to destroy your foundation.
Those who don’t know better think this is a harmful technique.
Ignoring the content of the first page, Xu Yang continued to turn to the next page.
"You can still practice this skill without destroying your foundation."
"The price is to stay in the Qi Refining Realm for the rest of your life."
"If you practice this technique if your realm is higher than the Qi Refining realm, your realm will automatically drop to the Qi Refining realm."
"Note: Once you practice, you cannot stop it."
"If you want to practice this skill, think twice and remember! Remember!!!"
"..." After reading the second page, Xu Yang was speechless.
"Since it can be used without abolishing the foundation, what's the use of writing that sentence on the first page..."
"Forget it, the key point is the price, staying in the Qi Refining realm for the rest of your life."
